aspiration-i-seek-to-prove-myself.name: Aspiration. I seek to prove myself worthy of my god's favor by matching my actions against his or her teachings.

change-we-must-help-bring-about.name: Change. We must help bring about the changes the gods are constantly working in the world.

charity-i-always-try-to-help.name: Charity. I always try to help those in need, no matter what the personal cost.

everything-i-do-is-for-the.name: Everything I do is for the common people.

faith-i-trust-that-my-deity.name: Faith. I trust that my deity will guide my actions. I have faith that if I work hard, things will go well.

i-am-inflexible-in-my-thinking.name: I am inflexible in my thinking.

i-am-suspicious-of-strangers-and.name: I am suspicious of strangers and expect the worst of them.

i-am-tolerant-or-intolerant-of.name: I am tolerant (or intolerant) of other faiths and respect (or condemn) the worship of other gods.

i-can-find-common-ground-between.name: I can find common ground between the fiercest enemies, empathizing with them and always working toward peace.

i-idolize-a-particular-hero-of.name: I idolize a particular hero of my faith, and constantly refer to that person's deeds and example.

i-judge-others-harshly-and-myself.name: I judge others harshly, and myself even more severely.

i-owe-my-life-to-the.name: I owe my life to the priest who took me in when my parents died.

i-put-too-much-trust-in.name: I put too much trust in those who wield power within my temple's hierarchy.

i-quote-or-misquote-sacred-texts.name: I quote (or misquote) sacred texts and proverbs in almost every situation.

i-see-omens-in-every-event.name: I see omens in every event and action. The gods try to speak to us, we just need to listen.

i-seek-to-preserve-a-sacred.name: I seek to preserve a sacred text that my enemies consider heretical and seek to destroy.

i-will-do-anything-to-protect.name: I will do anything to protect the temple where I served.

i-will-someday-get-revenge-on.name: I will someday get revenge on the corrupt temple hierarchy who branded me a heretic.

i-would-die-to-recover-an.name: I would die to recover an ancient relic of my faith that was lost long ago.

ive-enjoyed-fine-food-drink-and.name: I've enjoyed fine food, drink, and high society among my temple's elite. Rough living grates on me.

ive-spent-so-long-in-the.name: I've spent so long in the temple that I have little practical experience dealing with people in the outside world.

my-piety-sometimes-leads-me-to.name: My piety sometimes leads me to blindly trust those that profess faith in my god.

nothing-can-shake-my-optimistic-attitude.name: Nothing can shake my optimistic attitude.

once-i-pick-a-goal-i.name: Once I pick a goal, I become obsessed with it to the detriment of everything else in my life.

power-i-hope-to-one-day.name: Power. I hope to one day rise to the top of my faith's religious hierarchy.

tradition-the-ancient-traditions-of-wors.name: Tradition. The ancient traditions of worship and sacrifice must be preserved and upheld.

i-cant-resist-a-pretty-face.name: I can't resist a pretty face.

im-always-in-debt-i-spend.name: I'm always in debt. I spend my ill-gotten gains on decadent luxuries faster than I bring them in.

im-convinced-that-no-one-could.name: I'm convinced that no one could ever fool me the way I fool others.

im-too-greedy-for-my-own.name: I'm too greedy for my own good. I can't resist taking a risk if there's money involved.

i-cant-resist-swindling-people-who.name: I can't resist swindling people who are more powerful than me.

i-hate-to-admit-it-and.name: I hate to admit it and will hate myself for it, but I'll run and preserve my own hide if the going gets tough.

i-fleeced-the-wrong-person-and.name: I fleeced the wrong person and must work to ensure that this individual never crosses paths with me or those I care about.

i-owe-everything-to-my-mentora.name: I owe everything to my mentor—a horrible person who's probably rotting in jail somewhere.

somewhere-out-there-i-have-a.name: Somewhere out there, I have a child who doesn't know me. I'm making the world better for him or her.

i-come-from-a-noble-family.name: I come from a noble family, and one day I'll reclaim my lands and title from those who stole them from me.

a-powerful-person-killed-someone-i.name: A powerful person killed someone I love. Some day soon, I'll have my revenge.

i-swindled-and-ruined-a-person.name: I swindled and ruined a person who didn't deserve it. I seek to atone for my misdeeds but might never be able to forgive myself.

independence-i-am-a-free-spiritno.name: Independence. I am a free spirit—no one tells me what to do. (Chaotic)

fairness-i-never-target-people-who.name: Fairness. I never target people who can't afford to lose a few coins. (Lawful)

charity-i-distribute-the-money-i.name: Charity. I distribute the money I acquire to the people who really need it. (Good)

creativity-i-never-run-the-same.name: Creativity. I never run the same con twice. (Chaotic)

friendship-material-goods-come-and-go.name: Friendship. Material goods come and go. Bonds of friendship last forever. (Good)

aspiration-im-determined-to-make-somethi.name: Aspiration. I'm determined to make something of myself. (Any)

i-fall-in-and-out-of.name: I fall in and out of love easily, and am always pursuing someone.

i-have-a-joke-for-every.name: I have a joke for every occasion, especially occasions where humor is inappropriate.

flattery-is-my-preferred-trick-for.name: Flattery is my preferred trick for getting what I want.

im-a-born-gambler-who-cant.name: I'm a born gambler who can't resist taking a risk for a potential payoff.

i-lie-about-almost-everything-even.name: I lie about almost everything, even when there's no reason to.

sarcasm-and-insults-are-my-weapons.name: Sarcasm and insults are my weapons of choice.

i-keep-multiple-holy-symbols-on.name: I keep multiple holy symbols on me and invoke whatever deity might come in useful at any given moment.

i-pocket-anything-i-see-that.name: I pocket anything I see that might have some value.

when-i-see-something-valuable-i.name: When I see something valuable, I can't think about anything but how to steal it.

when-faced-with-a-choice-between.name: When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.

if-theres-a-plan-ill-forget.name: If there's a plan, I'll forget it. If I don't forget it, I'll ignore it.

i-have-a-tell-that-reveals.name: I have a 'tell' that reveals when I'm lying.

i-turn-tail-and-run-when.name: I turn tail and run when things look bad.

an-innocent-person-is-in-prison.name: An innocent person is in prison for a crime that I committed. I'm okay with that.

im-trying-to-pay-off-an.name: I'm trying to pay off an old debt I owe to a generous benefactor.

my-ill-gotten-gains-go-to-support.name: My ill-gotten gains go to support my family.

something-important-was-taken-from-me.name: Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.

i-will-become-the-greatest-thief.name: I will become the greatest thief that ever lived.

im-guilty-of-a-terrible-crime.name: I'm guilty of a terrible crime. I hope I can redeem myself for it.

someone-i-loved-died-because-of.name: Someone I loved died because of a mistake I made. That will never happen again.

honor-i-dont-steal-from-others.name: Honor. I don't steal from others in the trade. (Lawful)

freedom-chains-are-meant-to-be.name: Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them. (Chaotic)

charity-i-steal-from-the-wealthy.name: Charity. I steal from the wealthy so that I can help people in need. (Good)

greed-i-will-do-whatever-it.name: Greed. I will do whatever it takes to become wealthy. (Evil)

people-im-loyal-to-my-friends.name: People. I'm loyal to my friends, not to any ideals, and everyone else can take a trip down the Styx for all I care. (Neutral)

redemption-theres-a-spark-of-good.name: Redemption. There's a spark of good in everyone. (Good)

i-always-have-a-plan-for.name: I always have a plan for when things go wrong.

i-am-always-calm-no-matter.name: I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.

the-first-thing-i-do-in.name: The first thing I do in a new place is note the locations of everything valuable—or where such things could be hidden.

i-would-rather-make-a-new.name: I would rather make a new friend than a new enemy.

i-am-incredibly-slow-to-trust.name: I am incredibly slow to trust. Those who seem the fairest often have the most to hide.

i-dont-pay-attention-to-the.name: I don't pay attention to the risks in a situation. Never tell me the odds.

the-best-way-to-get-me.name: The best way to get me to do something is to tell me I can't do it.

i-blow-up-at-the-slightest.name: I blow up at the slightest insult.

ill-do-anything-to-win-fame.name: I'll do anything to win fame and renown.

im-a-sucker-for-a-pretty.name: I'm a sucker for a pretty face.

a-scandal-prevents-me-from-ever.name: A scandal prevents me from ever going home again. That kind of trouble seems to follow me around.

i-once-satirized-a-noble-who.name: I once satirized a noble who still wants my head. It was a mistake that I will likely repeat.

i-have-trouble-keeping-my-true.name: I have trouble keeping my true feelings hidden. My sharp tongue lands me in trouble.

despite-my-best-efforts-i-am.name: Despite my best efforts, I am unreliable to my friends.

my-instrument-is-my-most-treasured.name: My instrument is my most treasured possession, and it reminds me of someone I love.

someone-stole-my-precious-instrument-and.name: Someone stole my precious instrument, and someday I'll get it back.

i-want-to-be-famous-whatever.name: I want to be famous, whatever it takes.

i-idolize-a-hero-of-the.name: I idolize a hero of the old tales and measure my deeds against that person's.

i-will-do-anything-to-prove.name: I will do anything to prove myself superior to my hated rival.

i-would-do-anything-for-the.name: I would do anything for the other members of my old troupe.

beauty-when-i-perform-i-make.name: Beauty. When I perform, I make the world better than it was. (Good)

tradition-the-stories-legends-and-songs.name: Tradition. The stories, legends, and songs of the past must never be forgotten, for they teach us who we are. (Lawful)

creativity-the-world-is-in-need.name: Creativity. The world is in need of new ideas and bold action. (Chaotic)

greed-im-only-in-it-for.name: Greed. I'm only in it for the money. (Evil)

people-i-like-seeing-the-smiles.name: People. I like seeing the smiles on people's faces when I perform. That's all that matters. (Neutral)

honesty-art-should-reflect-the-soul.name: Honesty. Art should reflect the soul; it should come from within and reveal who we really are. (Any)

i-know-a-story-relevant-to.name: I know a story relevant to almost every situation.

whenever-i-come-to-a-new.name: Whenever I come to a new place, I collect local rumors and spread gossip.

im-a-hopeless-romantic-always-searching.name: I'm a hopeless romantic, always searching for that "special someone".

nobody-stays-angry-at-me-or.name: Nobody stays angry at me or around me for long, since I can defuse any amount of tension.

i-love-a-good-insult-even.name: I love a good insult, even one directed at me.

i-get-bitter-if-im-not.name: I get bitter if I'm not the center of attention.

ill-settle-for-nothing-less-than.name: I'll settle for nothing less than perfection.

i-change-my-mood-or-my.name: I change my mood or my mind as quickly as I change key in a song.

the-tyrant-who-rules-my-land.name: The tyrant who rules my land will stop at nothing to see me killed.

im-convinced-of-the-significance-of.name: I'm convinced of the significance of my destiny, and blind to my shortcomings and the risk of failure.

the-people-who-knew-me-when.name: The people who knew me when I was young know my shameful secret, so I can never go home again.

i-have-a-weakness-for-the.name: I have a weakness for the vices of the city, especially hard drink.

secretly-i-believe-that-things-would.name: Secretly, I believe that things would be better if I were a tyrant lording over the land.

i-have-trouble-trusting-in-my.name: I have trouble trusting in my allies.

i-have-a-family-but-i.name: I have a family, but I have no idea where they are. One day, I hope to see them again.

i-worked-the-land-i-love.name: I worked the land, I love the land, and I will protect the land.

a-proud-noble-once-gave-me.name: A proud noble once gave me a horrible beating, and I will take my revenge on any bully I encounter.

my-tools-are-symbols-of-my.name: My tools are symbols of my past life, and I carry them so that I will never forget my roots.

i-protect-those-who-cannot-protect.name: I protect those who cannot protect themselves.

i-wish-my-childhood-sweetheart-had.name: I wish my childhood sweetheart had come with me to pursue my destiny.

respect-people-deserve-to-be-treated.name: Respect. People deserve to be treated with dignity and respect. (Good)

fairness-no-one-should-get-preferential.name: Fairness. No one should get preferential treatment before the law, and no one is above the law. (Lawful)

freedom-tyrants-must-not-be-allowed.name: Freedom. Tyrants must not be allowed to oppress the people. (Chaotic)

might-if-i-become-strong-i.name: Might. If I become strong, I can take what I want—what I deserve. (Evil)

sincerity-theres-no-good-in-pretending.name: Sincerity. There's no good in pretending to be something I'm not. (Neutral)

destiny-nothing-and-no-one-can.name: Destiny. Nothing and no one can steer me away from my higher calling. (Any)

i-judge-people-by-their-actions.name: I judge people by their actions, not their words.

if-someone-is-in-trouble-im.name: If someone is in trouble, I'm always ready to lend help.

when-i-set-my-mind-to.name: When I set my mind to something, I follow through no matter what gets in my way.

i-have-a-strong-sense-of.name: I have a strong sense of fair play and always try to find the most equitable solution to arguments.

im-confident-in-my-own-abilities.name: I'm confident in my own abilities and do what I can to instill confidence in others.

thinking-is-for-other-people-i.name: Thinking is for other people. I prefer action.

i-misuse-long-words-in-an.name: I misuse long words in an attempt to sound smarter.

i-get-bored-easily-when-am.name: I get bored easily. When am I going to get on with my destiny?

ill-do-anything-to-get-my.name: I'll do anything to get my hands on something rare or priceless.

im-quick-to-assume-that-someone.name: I'm quick to assume that someone is trying to cheat me.

no-one-must-ever-learn-that.name: No one must ever learn that I once stole money from guild coffers.

im-never-satisfied-with-what-i.name: I'm never satisfied with what I have—I always want more.

i-would-kill-to-acquire-a.name: I would kill to acquire a noble title.

im-horribly-jealous-of-anyone-who.name: I'm horribly jealous of anyone who can outshine my handiwork. Everywhere I go, I'm surrounded by rivals.

the-workshop-where-i-learned-my.name: The workshop where I learned my trade is the most important place in the world to me.

i-created-a-great-work-for.name: I created a great work for someone, and then found them unworthy to receive it. I'm still looking for someone worthy.

i-owe-my-guild-a-great.name: I owe my guild a great debt for forging me into the person I am today.

i-pursue-wealth-to-secure-someones.name: I pursue wealth to secure someone's love.

one-day-i-will-return-to.name: One day I will return to my guild and prove that I am the greatest artisan of them all.

i-will-get-revenge-on-the.name: I will get revenge on the evil forces that destroyed my place of business and ruined my livelihood.

community-it-is-the-duty-of.name: Community. It is the duty of all civilized people to strengthen the bonds of community and the security of civilization. (Lawful)

generosity-my-talents-were-given-to.name: Generosity. My talents were given to me so that I could use them to benefit the world. (Good)

freedom-everyone-should-be-free-to.name: Freedom. Everyone should be free to pursue his or her own livelihood. (Chaotic)

people-im-committed-to-the-people.name: People. I'm committed to the people I care about, not to ideals. (Neutral)

aspiration-i-work-hard-to-be.name: Aspiration. I work hard to be the best there is at my craft. (Any)

i-believe-that-anything-worth-doing.name: I believe that anything worth doing is worth doing right. I can't help it—I'm a perfectionist.

im-a-snob-who-looks-down.name: I'm a snob who looks down on those who can't appreciate fine art.

i-always-want-to-know-how.name: I always want to know how things work and what makes people tick.

im-full-of-witty-aphorisms-and.name: I'm full of witty aphorisms and have a proverb for every occasion.

im-rude-to-people-who-lack.name: I'm rude to people who lack my commitment to hard work and fair play.

i-like-to-talk-at-length.name: I like to talk at length about my profession.

i-dont-part-with-my-money.name: I don't part with my money easily and will haggle tirelessly to get the best deal possible.

im-well-known-for-my-work.name: I'm well known for my work, and I want to make sure everyone appreciates it. I'm always taken aback when people haven't heard of me.

now-that-ive-returned-to-the.name: Now that I've returned to the world, I enjoy its delights a little too much.

i-harbor-dark-bloodthirsty-thoughts-that.name: I harbor dark, bloodthirsty thoughts that my isolation and meditation failed to quell.

i-am-dogmatic-in-my-thoughts.name: I am dogmatic in my thoughts and philosophy.

i-let-my-need-to-win.name: I let my need to win arguments overshadow friendships and harmony.

id-risk-too-much-to-uncover.name: I'd risk too much to uncover a lost bit of knowledge.

i-like-keeping-secrets-and-wont.name: I like keeping secrets and won't share them with anyone.

nothing-is-more-important-than-the.name: Nothing is more important than the other members of my family.

i-entered-seclusion-to-hide-from.name: I entered seclusion to hide from the ones who might still be hunting me. I must someday confront them.

im-still-seeking-the-enlightenment-i.name: I'm still seeking the enlightenment I pursued in my seclusion, and it still eludes me.

i-entered-seclusion-because-i-loved.name: I entered seclusion because I loved someone I could not have.

should-my-discovery-come-to-light.name: Should my discovery come to light, it could bring ruin to the world.

my-isolation-gave-me-great-insight.name: My isolation gave me great insight into a great evil that only I can destroy.

greater-good-my-gifts-are-meant.name: Greater Good. My gifts are meant to be shared with all, not used for my own benefit. (Good)

logic-emotions-must-not-cloud-our.name: Logic. Emotions must not cloud our logical thinking. (Lawful)

free-thinking-inquiry-and-curiosity-are.name: Free Thinking. Inquiry and curiosity are the pillars of progress. (Chaotic)

power-solitude-and-contemplation-are-pat.name: Power. Solitude and contemplation are paths toward mystical or magical power. (Evil)

live-and-let-live-meddling-in.name: Live and Let Live. Meddling in the affairs of others only causes trouble. (Neutral)

self-knowledge-if-you-know-yourself-ther.name: Self-Knowledge. If you know yourself, there's nothing left to know. (Any)

ive-been-isolated-for-so-long.name: I've been isolated for so long that I rarely speak, preferring gestures and the occasional grunt.

i-am-utterly-serene-even-in.name: I am utterly serene, even in the face of disaster.

the-leader-of-my-community-had.name: The leader of my community had something wise to say on every topic, and I am eager to share that wisdom.

i-feel-tremendous-empathy-for-all.name: I feel tremendous empathy for all who suffer.

im-oblivious-to-etiquette-and-social.name: I'm oblivious to etiquette and social expectations.

i-connect-everything-that-happens-to.name: I connect everything that happens to me to a grand, cosmic plan.

i-often-get-lost-in-my.name: I often get lost in my own thoughts and contemplation, becoming oblivious to my surroundings.

i-am-working-on-a-grand.name: I am working on a grand philosophical theory and love sharing my ideas.

i-secretly-believe-that-everyone-is.name: I secretly believe that everyone is beneath me.

i-hide-a-truly-scandalous-secret.name: I hide a truly scandalous secret that could ruin my family forever.

i-too-often-hear-veiled-insults.name: I too often hear veiled insults and threats in every word addressed to me, and I'm quick to anger.

i-have-an-insatiable-desire-for.name: I have an insatiable desire for carnal pleasures.

in-fact-the-world-does-revolve.name: In fact, the world does revolve around me.

by-my-words-and-actions-i.name: By my words and actions, I often bring shame to my family.

i-will-face-any-challenge-to.name: I will face any challenge to win the approval of my family.

my-houses-alliance-with-another-noble.name: My house's alliance with another noble family must be sustained at all costs.

i-am-in-love-with-the.name: I am in love with the heir of a family that my family despises.

my-loyalty-to-my-sovereign-is.name: My loyalty to my sovereign is unwavering.

the-common-folk-must-see-me.name: The common folk must see me as a hero of the people.

respect-respect-is-due-to-me.name: Respect. Respect is due to me because of my position, but all people regardless of station deserve to be treated with dignity. (Good)

responsibility-it-is-my-duty-to.name: Responsibility. It is my duty to respect the authority of those above me, just as those below me must respect mine. (Lawful)

independence-i-must-prove-that-i.name: Independence. I must prove that I can handle myself without coddling from my family. (Chaotic)

power-if-i-can-attain-more.name: Power. If I can attain more power, no one will tell me what to do. (Evil)

family-blood-runs-thicker-than-water.name: Family. Blood runs thicker than water. (Any)

noble-obligation-it-is-my-duty.name: Noble Obligation. It is my duty to protect and care for the people beneath me. (Good)

my-eloquent-flattery-makes-everyone-i.name: My eloquent flattery makes everyone I talk to feel like the most wonderful and important person in the world.

the-common-folk-love-me-for.name: The common folk love me for my kindness and generosity.

no-one-could-doubt-by-looking.name: No one could doubt by looking at my regal bearing that I am a cut above the unwashed masses.

i-take-great-pains-to-always.name: I take great pains to always look my best and follow the latest fashions.

i-dont-like-to-get-my.name: I don't like to get my hands dirty, and I won't be caught dead in unsuitable accommodations.

despite-my-noble-birth-i-do.name: Despite my noble birth, I do not place myself above other folk. We all have the same blood.

my-favor-once-lost-is-lost.name: My favor, once lost, is lost forever.

if-you-do-me-an-injury.name: If you do me an injury, I will crush you, ruin your name, and salt your fields.

i-am-too-enamored-of-ale.name: I am too enamored of ale, wine, and other intoxicants.

theres-no-room-for-caution-in.name: There's no room for caution in a life lived to the fullest.

i-remember-every-insult-ive-received.name: I remember every insult I've received and nurse a silent resentment toward anyone who's ever wronged me.

i-am-slow-to-trust-members.name: I am slow to trust members of other races, tribes, and societies.

violence-is-my-answer-to-almost.name: Violence is my answer to almost any challenge.

dont-expect-me-to-save-those.name: Don't expect me to save those who can't save themselves. It is nature's way that the strong thrive and the weak perish.

my-family-clan-or-tribe-is.name: My family, clan, or tribe is the most important thing in my life, even when they are far from me.

an-injury-to-the-unspoiled-wilderness.name: An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.

i-will-bring-terrible-wrath-down.name: I will bring terrible wrath down on the evildoers who destroyed my homeland.

i-am-the-last-of-my.name: I am the last of my tribe, and it is up to me to ensure their names enter legend.

i-suffer-awful-visions-of-a.name: I suffer awful visions of a coming disaster and will do anything to prevent it.

it-is-my-duty-to-provide.name: It is my duty to provide children to sustain my tribe.

change-life-is-like-the-seasons.name: Change. Life is like the seasons, in constant change, and we must change with it. (Chaotic)

greater-good-it-is-each-persons.name: Greater Good. It is each person's responsibility to make the most happiness for the whole tribe. (Good)

honor-if-i-dishonor-myself-i.name: Honor. If I dishonor myself, I dishonor my whole clan. (Lawful)

might-the-strongest-are-meant-to.name: Might. The strongest are meant to rule. (Evil)

nature-the-natural-world-is-more.name: Nature. The natural world is more important than all the constructs of civilization. (Neutral)

glory-i-must-earn-glory-in.name: Glory. I must earn glory in battle, for myself and my clan. (Any)

im-driven-by-a-wanderlust-that.name: I'm driven by a wanderlust that led me away from home.

i-watch-over-my-friends-as.name: I watch over my friends as if they were a litter of newborn pups.

i-once-ran-twenty-five-miles-without.name: I once ran twenty-five miles without stopping to warn my clan of an approaching orc horde. I'd do it again if I had to.

i-have-a-lesson-for-every.name: I have a lesson for every situation, drawn from observing nature.

i-place-no-stock-in-wealthy.name: I place no stock in wealthy or well-mannered folk. Money and manners won't save you from a hungry owlbear.

im-always-picking-things-up-absently.name: I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.

i-feel-far-more-comfortable-around.name: I feel far more comfortable around animals than people.

i-was-in-fact-raised-by.name: I was, in fact, raised by wolves.

i-am-easily-distracted-by-the.name: I am easily distracted by the promise of information.

most-people-scream-and-run-when.name: Most people scream and run when they see a demon. I stop and take notes on its anatomy.

unlocking-an-ancient-mystery-is-worth.name: Unlocking an ancient mystery is worth the price of a civilization.

i-overlook-obvious-solutions-in-favor.name: I overlook obvious solutions in favor of complicated ones.

i-speak-without-really-thinking-through.name: I speak without really thinking through my words, invariably insulting others.

i-cant-keep-a-secret-to.name: I can't keep a secret to save my life, or anyone else's.

it-is-my-duty-to-protect.name: It is my duty to protect my students.

i-have-an-ancient-text-that.name: I have an ancient text that holds terrible secrets that must not fall into the wrong hands.

i-work-to-preserve-a-library.name: I work to preserve a library, university, scriptorium, or monastery.

my-lifes-work-is-a-series.name: My life's work is a series of tomes related to a specific field of lore.

ive-been-searching-my-whole-life.name: I've been searching my whole life for the answer to a certain question.

i-sold-my-soul-for-knowledge.name: I sold my soul for knowledge. I hope to do great deeds and win it back.

knowledge-the-path-to-power-and.name: Knowledge. The path to power and self-improvement is through knowledge. (Neutral)

beauty-what-is-beautiful-points-us.name: Beauty. What is beautiful points us beyond itself toward what is true. (Good)

no-limits-nothing-should-fetter-the.name: No Limits. Nothing should fetter the infinite possibility inherent in all existence. (Chaotic)

power-knowledge-is-the-path-to.name: Power. Knowledge is the path to power and domination. (Evil)

self-improvement-the-goal-of-a-life.name: Self-Improvement. The goal of a life of study is the betterment of oneself. (Any)

i-use-polysyllabic-words-that-convey.name: I use polysyllabic words that convey the impression of great erudition.

ive-read-every-book-in-the.name: I've read every book in the world's greatest libraries—or I like to boast that I have.

im-used-to-helping-out-those.name: I'm used to helping out those who aren't as smart as I am, and I patiently explain anything and everything to others.

theres-nothing-i-like-more-than.name: There's nothing I like more than a good mystery.

im-willing-to-listen-to-every.name: I'm willing to listen to every side of an argument before I make my own judgment.

i-speak-slowly-when-talking-to.name: I... speak... slowly... when talking... to idiots,... which... almost... everyone... is... compared... to me.

i-am-horribly-horribly-awkward-in.name: I am horribly, horribly awkward in social situations.

im-convinced-that-people-are-always.name: I'm convinced that people are always trying to steal my secrets.

i-follow-orders-even-if-i.name: I follow orders, even if I think they're wrong.

ill-say-anything-to-avoid-having.name: I'll say anything to avoid having to do extra work.

once-someone-questions-my-courage-i.name: Once someone questions my courage, I never back down no matter how dangerous the situation.

once-i-start-drinking-its-hard.name: Once I start drinking, it's hard for me to stop.

i-cant-help-but-pocket-loose.name: I can't help but pocket loose coins and other trinkets I come across.

my-pride-will-probably-lead-to.name: My pride will probably lead to my destruction.

im-loyal-to-my-captain-first.name: I'm loyal to my captain first, everything else second.

the-ship-is-most-importantcrewmates-and.name: The ship is most important—crewmates and captains come and go.

ill-always-remember-my-first-ship.name: I'll always remember my first ship.

in-a-harbor-town-i-have.name: In a harbor town, I have a paramour whose eyes nearly stole me from the sea.

i-was-cheated-out-of-my.name: I was cheated out of my fair share of the profits, and I want to get my due.

ruthless-pirates-murdered-my-captain-and.name: Ruthless pirates murdered my captain and crewmates, plundered our ship, and left me to die. Vengeance will be mine.

respect-the-thing-that-keeps-a.name: Respect. The thing that keeps a ship together is mutual respect between captain and crew. (Good)

fairness-we-all-do-the-work.name: Fairness. We all do the work, so we all share in the rewards. (Lawful)

freedom-the-sea-is-freedomthe-freedom.name: Freedom. The sea is freedom—the freedom to go anywhere and do anything. (Chaotic)

mastery-im-a-predator-and-the.name: Mastery. I'm a predator, and the other ships on the sea are my prey. (Evil)

people-im-committed-to-my-crewmates.name: People. I'm committed to my crewmates, not to ideals. (Neutral)

aspiration-someday-ill-own-my-own.name: Aspiration. Someday, I'll own my own ship and chart my own destiny. (Any)

my-friends-know-they-can-rely.name: My friends know they can rely on me, no matter what.

i-work-hard-so-that-i.name: I work hard so that I can play hard when the work is done.

i-enjoy-sailing-into-new-ports.name: I enjoy sailing into new ports and making new friends over a flagon of ale.

i-stretch-the-truth-for-the.name: I stretch the truth for the sake of a good story.

to-me-a-tavern-brawl-is.name: To me, a tavern brawl is a nice way to get to know a new city.

i-never-pass-up-a-friendly.name: I never pass up a friendly wager.

my-language-is-as-foul-as.name: My language is as foul as an otyugh nest.

i-like-a-job-well-done.name: I like a job well done, especially if I can convince someone else to do it.

the-monstrous-enemy-we-faced-in.name: The monstrous enemy we faced in battle still leaves me quivering with fear.

i-have-little-respect-for-anyone.name: I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.

i-made-a-terrible-mistake-in.name: I made a terrible mistake in battle that cost many lives—and I would do anything to keep that mistake secret.

my-hatred-of-my-enemies-is.name: My hatred of my enemies is blinding and unreasoning.

i-obey-the-law-even-if.name: I obey the law, even if the law causes misery.

id-rather-eat-my-armor-than.name: I'd rather eat my armor than admit when I'm wrong.

i-would-still-lay-down-my.name: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.

someone-saved-my-life-on-the.name: Someone saved my life on the battlefield. To this day, I will never leave a friend behind.

ill-never-forget-the-crushing-defeat.name: I'll never forget the crushing defeat my company suffered or the enemies who dealt it.

those-who-fight-beside-me-are.name: Those who fight beside me are those worth dying for.

i-fight-for-those-who-cannot.name: I fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.

greater-good-our-lot-is-to.name: Greater Good. Our lot is to lay down our lives in defense of others. (Good)

responsibility-i-do-what-i-must.name: Responsibility. I do what I must and obey just authority. (Lawful)

independence-when-people-follow-orders-b.name: Independence. When people follow orders blindly, they embrace a kind of tyranny. (Chaotic)

might-in-life-as-in-war.name: Might. In life as in war, the stronger force wins. (Evil)

live-and-let-live-ideals-arent.name: Live and Let Live. Ideals aren't worth killing over or going to war for. (Neutral)

nation-my-city-nation-or-people.name: Nation. My city, nation, or people are all that matter. (Any)

im-haunted-by-memories-of-war.name: I'm haunted by memories of war. I can't get the images of violence out of my mind.

ive-lost-too-many-friends-and.name: I've lost too many friends, and I'm slow to make new ones.

im-full-of-inspiring-and-cautionary.name: I'm full of inspiring and cautionary tales from my military experience relevant to almost every combat situation.

i-can-stare-down-a-hell.name: I can stare down a hell hound without flinching.

i-enjoy-being-strong-and-like.name: I enjoy being strong and like breaking things.

i-have-a-crude-sense-of.name: I have a crude sense of humor.

i-face-problems-head-on-a-simple.name: I face problems head-on. A simple, direct solution is the best path to success.

if-im-outnumbered-i-will-run.name: If I'm outnumbered, I will run away from a fight.

gold-seems-like-a-lot-of.name: Gold seems like a lot of money to me, and I'll do just about anything for more of it.

i-will-never-fully-trust-anyone.name: I will never fully trust anyone other than myself.

id-rather-kill-someone-in-their.name: I'd rather kill someone in their sleep than fight fair.

its-not-stealing-if-i-need.name: It's not stealing if I need it more than someone else.

people-who-cant-take-care-of.name: People who can't take care of themselves get what they deserve.

my-town-or-city-is-my.name: My town or city is my home, and I'll fight to defend it.

i-sponsor-an-orphanage-to-keep.name: I sponsor an orphanage to keep others from enduring what I was forced to endure.

i-owe-my-survival-to-another.name: I owe my survival to another urchin who taught me to live on the streets.

i-owe-a-debt-i-can.name: I owe a debt I can never repay to the person who took pity on me.

i-escaped-my-life-of-poverty.name: I escaped my life of poverty by robbing an important person, and I'm wanted for it.

no-one-else-should-have-to.name: No one else should have to endure the hardships I've been through.

respect-all-people-rich-or-poor.name: Respect. All people, rich or poor, deserve respect. (Good)

community-we-have-to-take-care.name: Community. We have to take care of each other, because no one else is going to do it. (Lawful)

change-the-low-are-lifted-up.name: Change. The low are lifted up, and the high and mighty are brought down. Change is the nature of things. (Chaotic)

retribution-the-rich-need-to-be.name: Retribution. The rich need to be shown what life and death are like in the gutters. (Evil)

people-i-help-the-people-who.name: People. I help the people who help me—that's what keeps us alive. (Neutral)

aspiration-im-going-to-prove-that.name: Aspiration. I'm going to prove that I'm worthy of a better life. (Any)

i-hide-scraps-of-food-and.name: I hide scraps of food and trinkets away in my pockets.

i-ask-a-lot-of-questions.name: I ask a lot of questions.

i-like-to-squeeze-into-small.name: I like to squeeze into small places where no one else can get to me.

i-sleep-with-my-back-to.name: I sleep with my back to a wall or tree, with everything I own wrapped in a bundle in my arms.

i-eat-like-a-pig-and.name: I eat like a pig and have bad manners.

i-think-anyone-whos-nice-to.name: I think anyone who's nice to me is hiding evil intent.

i-bluntly-say-what-others-are.name: I bluntly say what others are hinting at or hiding.
